newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Nov 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Nov 26.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Bangladesh's cabinet has approved a draft law barring import of seeds without the permission of the government's National Seed Board.
Police on Monday unearthed a printing press in Dhaka which was forging share certificates of different companies listed with the Dhaka Stock Exchange.
A draft national policy on HIV/AIDS was now under scrutiny of the government, Health Minister Salahuddin Yusuf said on Monday.
Opposition leader and former Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia leaves for Saudi Arabia on Wednesday for treatment.
Chief Minister of India's West Bengal state Jyoti Basu arrives in Dhaka on Wednesday to discuss water sharing issues with Bangladesh government.
New governor of Bangladesh (central) Bank Lutfar Rahman Sarkar said on Monday increased participation of foreign banks in the country's financial market would help improve efficiency of local banks.
Over 61 percent of the country's 56 million workforce are either unemployed or under-employed, said Metropolitan Chamber of Commerce and Industry.
